question.text: Ms. Kavita Rao manages a legacy Venture Capital Fund registered under SEBI (VCF) Regulations, 1996 and wishes to migrate to the AIF Regulations as a 'Migrated Venture Capital Fund'. Per the SEBI circular dated June 6, 2025, the deadline for such migration with two-thirds investor consent by value was:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the SEBI circular dated June 6, 2025, VCFs registered under the SEBI (Venture Capital Funds) Regulations, 1996 could seek registration under the SEBI (AIF) Regulations as a 'Migrated Venture Capital Fund' subject to approval of two-thirds of their investors by value within July 19, 2025. The facility of migration was available till July 19, 2025. The Trap: The other dates are plausible near-terms but are not the regulatory deadline specified in the June 6, 2025 circular. Note: Workbook pages 52 and 325-326 support the migrated-VCF deadline of July 19, 2025 and the two-thirds investor consent threshold.
